item.title: CCW is an Art with a Touch of Science and a Serious Commitment
item.description: I started carrying a pistol concealed in 1983 and continue doing so to this day. For most of my adult life, it was all about being a cop, with the last 16 years as a lawfully armed concealed carry holder and trainer. Everything from a 4-inch full-sized revolver to some of the most compact pistols has been carried and properly concealed. item.description: While many have proclaimed their death, revolvers still remain a popular handgun. Their general small size and ease of use make them a solid EDC weapon. item.title: Full-Size Handguns from SHOT Show 2026: The Year’s Best
item.description: SHOT Show 2026 had plenty of new full-size handguns on display. Some were brand new, while others were established designs with new features.
